faq.question: Can I launch my own smart home camera brand with Adiance?
faq.answer: Yes. Adiance provides a complete white-label smart home camera ecosystem. You receive cameras with your branding, a custom mobile app published under your developer account on App Store and Google Play, cloud storage infrastructure, retail packaging design, and ongoing firmware support. Many retail brands and Amazon sellers use Adiance to launch their own camera brands.

faq.question: What is the minimum order quantity for smart home OEM cameras?
faq.answer: Adiance offers flexible MOQs starting from 500 units for initial orders, making it accessible for startups and emerging brands. Volume pricing improves significantly at 2,000+ and 5,000+ unit tiers. We also support Amazon FBA preparation including labeling, packaging, and direct warehouse shipping.

faq.question: Are Adiance pet cameras non-Chinese manufactured?
faq.answer: Yes. Adiance cameras are designed and manufactured in India using non-restricted SoC chipsets. This makes them an ideal alternative for brands seeking to diversify away from Chinese supply chains, comply with NDAA regulations, or market their products as non-Chinese origin — a growing competitive advantage in the US, European, and Australian retail markets.

faq.question: Does Adiance provide a mobile app with the cameras?
faq.answer: Yes. Adiance provides a fully white-labeled mobile app for iOS and Android. The app supports live viewing, two-way audio, motion alerts, cloud playback, device sharing, and push notifications. The app is published under your brand name and developer account, giving you complete brand ownership.

faq.question: Can Adiance supply cameras ready for Amazon FBA?
faq.answer: Yes. Adiance supports Amazon FBA sellers with complete fulfillment preparation including FNSKU labeling, retail-ready packaging, product insert cards, and direct shipping to Amazon fulfillment centers. We also provide product listing content, A+ content assets, and compliance documentation required for Amazon marketplace.

faq.question: What cloud storage options are available?
faq.answer: Adiance offers a white-label cloud storage platform with flexible subscription tiers. You can offer your customers free basic plans (e.g., 24-hour rolling storage) and premium paid plans (7-day, 30-day, continuous recording). The cloud platform generates recurring revenue for your brand through monthly subscriptions.

faq.question: How long does it take to launch a smart home camera brand with Adiance?
faq.answer: A typical timeline from initial discussion to first shipment is 8-12 weeks. This includes product selection and customization (2 weeks), app branding and configuration (2-3 weeks), packaging design and production (2-3 weeks), and manufacturing and quality testing (3-4 weeks). Existing camera models with standard customization can ship faster.
